The prompt:

Your client is a bank looking to improve its underwriting practices.

They’ve shared some loan application and performance data in the attached spreadsheet. For the first meeting with the bank’s president, you are to 

coordinate a ~20-minute presentation 

highlighting any insights you can draw from the data about the current state of the business (5 minutes max).

You are also to develop a proposed implementation plan for going live with Zest AI and 
share any questions you and the team would have that will enable to you to help the client use our software to go live with our AI driven underwriting. 

You have access to the following internal resources:
a customer success team that includes
an account manager, 
a data scientist, 
a backend software engineer (focused on deployment);

you also have access to the following external resources:
a credit bureau representative (can be used to source credit data),
a representative from the bank's loan origination system, with whom we can get the customer live scoring with their algorithm. 

Be sure to document any assumptions you’ve made along the way in creating the plan,
and what resources you would consult for the actual answers.



```{r}
library(tidyverse)

library(lubridate)
library(ggalluvial)
library(ggthemes)
library(moments)
library(ggcorrplot)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(ggalt)
library(data.table)
library(dtplyr)
library(stringr)

opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```
